justifications.r1: Explosive Gruul ramp suite (12+ dorks and 2-CMC ramp) deploying 7-mana Etali by Turn 4–5.
justifications.r2: Etali cast triggers cast 4 free spells from pods; recurring copy/blink loops generate immense card advantage.
justifications.a1: Redundancy of clone/blink and haste enablers (Twinflame, Heat Shimmer, Molten Duplication).
justifications.a2: Casts Etali and triggers initial wave by Turn 4.5–5.
justifications.p1: Presents massive multi-spell board parity break on Turns 5–6.
justifications.p2: Requires 2 opponent untaps to close the game via combat or poison flip.
justifications.p3: Etali is telegraphed in the command zone, but ETB triggers resolve regardless of spot removal.
justifications.i1: Light reactive interaction; primarily relies on stolen opponent spells.
justifications.i2: Incidental board disruption via Etali hits; no intentional stax.
justifications.s1: Moderate protection (Deflecting Swat, Heroic Intervention, Lightning Greaves).
justifications.s2: Etali ETB restocks board immediately even after mass board wipes.
justifications.s3: Deck is built entirely around Etali's ETB trigger.
